docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
Hi! I'm JNAtelier, a Technical Writer / Junior Developer / Data Analyst passionate about turning complex concepts into clear, accessible, and user-friendly solutions.

Currently

I am building my Docs-as-Code portfolio and exploring modern documentation workflows, automation, and web technologies.

docs.title: What I Do
docs.text:
• Technical Documentation: Creating structured user guides, tutorials, and API references using Markdown and MkDocs.

  • Problem Solving: Bridging the gap between technical teams and end users through clear communication.
